feature_recipe.F1: f1_ret_1_5 = C[t-1]/C[t-5]-1; f1_ret_5_20 = C[t-5]/C[t-20]-1; endpoints must be finite positive closes, otherwise NaN; no forward fill
feature_recipe.F2: amt_abn = log1p(amount_t) - median(log1p(amount[t-20:t-1])) with >=16 valid history values else NaN; negative/zero amount -> NaN before log1p; turn_abn identical construction on Factor33 'turn' (turn<=0 -> NaN); interactions = centred cross-sectional rank of ret_1 (resp. ret_5) times centred rank of amt_abn within the same legal pool, no future ranking
feature_recipe.F3: on = log(O_j/C[j-1]), intra = log(C_j/O_j); f3_on_intra_mean_5/20 = mean over the window of (on-intra) with >=min(16,window) valid days else NaN; f3_path_eff_20 = |sum(r)|/(sum|r|+1e-12), f3_downside_share_20 = sum(min(r,0)^2)/(sum(r^2)+1e-12), r = 20 one-day log returns (21 price points), >=16 valid returns else NaN
feature_recipe.suspension: suspended or missing days stay missing (no fill); the panel key set is identical to panel_platform (same legal pool)
